agent_protocol.subagent_brief: Plan 4 wires the first write-side stages: worktree-setup, coder (in revisionLoop with stub reviewer), and test-author. The plan markdown is a design brief; the controller (driver) curates full verbatim code in each implementer subagent's prompt. Each task is TDD: write failing test, verify failure, write minimal implementation, verify pass, commit. If you hit a typing or runtime error that the spec didn't anticipate, document the deviation.
agent_protocol.tdd_pattern: Tasks that include test files follow strict TDD: (1) write the failing test, (2) run the test to verify it fails with the expected message, (3) write the minimal implementation, (4) run the test to verify it passes, (5) commit. Do not write the implementation before seeing the test fail.
agent_protocol.completion_criteria: A task is complete only when every entry in 'verification_commands' exits 0 with the expected output AND the commit described in 'commit' has been created.
do_not: Do not skip the 'verify it fails' step.
Do not amend or rewrite earlier commits.
Do not run --no-verify or skip hooks.
Do not add features beyond what the task requires.
Do not introduce real network calls or real Claude SDK calls in tests. Mock the runner; mock the AdoClient; the worktree-manager tests use real git in a tmpdir but never push.
Do not extend the existing denylist-style canUseTool from the sibling — coder/test-author use a strict allowlist (Plan 4 locked decision).
Do not push branches in Plan 4 — push lands in Plan 5's draft-PR-creator.

tasks.name: Coder system prompt
tasks.summary: src/prompts/coder.md — role (write the implementation), commit hygiene rules (no push, no main edits, no rebase), output JSON schema, skill-usage instructions.

tasks.name: Coder stage
tasks.summary: src/pipeline/stages/coder.ts — createCoderStage({ runner, config, promptTemplate, discoveredSkills }). Records attempt-baseline SHA at top of execute. Reads state.outputs.analyzer / wiContext / worktree. Calls runner.run with cwd=worktree.path, tools=[Read,Grep,Glob,Bash,Skill,Edit,Write], disallowedTools=[NotebookEdit], canUseTool=composite(bashAllowlist, pathEscapeFilter), maxTurns=config.coderMaxTurns. Output schema { summary, filesChanged, commits }. On thrown AgentOutputParseError: reset worktree to baseline, retry up to 2x. On any other throw: reset worktree to baseline, re-throw.
